d: The iconic Rixos Gulf Hotel Doha offers a distinctive luxury lifestyle, combining warm Rixos hospitality with exceptional service, world-class amenities, vibrant entertainment, and innovative all-inclusive Food & Beverage concepts. With 378 beautifully appointed guest rooms, premium bedding, and an elegant atmosphere, the hotel delivers an unforgettable experience for every guest.
We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Guest Relations Agent (Arabic speaker) to join our vibrant team.

Under the guidance and supervision of the Guest Relations Supervisor and /or the Guest Relations Manager and within the limits of the established Rixos Hotels policies and procedure, Guest Relations Agent’s responsibilities are to provide efficient, personalized, courteous and punctual service which brings in the Turkish culture and hospitality to the lively capital of Qatar, Doha. To work with a team spirit and to ensure that each guest feel welcome from the moment they arrive and leaves the property fully satisfied with the wish to return back. Maintains the overall efficiency of set standards while creating rich lifestyle experiences, infusing Turkish culture and warm hospitality through our luxurious services and products; thereby providing the highest level of comfort and hospitality to guests so as to maximize organizational profitability and guest satisfaction in an atmosphere of teamwork and high employee morale.
q: Education: High school diploma or bachelor’s degree, preferably in Hospitality, Tourism, Hotel Management, or a related field.
Language skills: Fluent Arabic and English; additional languages are an advantage.
Customer service: Strong guest-service and interpersonal skills, with a professional and welcoming attitude.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication, including the ability to handle complaints diplomatically.
Experience: Previous experience in hotel guest relations, front office, reception, concierge, customer service, or luxury hospitality is preferred.
Cultural awareness: Ability to understand and respond appropriately to guests from different cultural backgrounds, particularly Arabic-speaking guests.
Problem-solving: Ability to resolve guest concerns quickly while maintaining a positive guest experience.
Professional presentation: Well-groomed, confident, courteous, and comfortable interacting with VIP guests.
Computer skills: Familiarity with hotel systems, email, Microsoft Office, and reservation/CRM systems.
Flexibility: Willingness to work shifts, weekends, holidays, and during busy periods.
Team player with a proactive and results-driven attitude.
Personal qualities: Patient, attentive to detail, proactive, organized, discreet, and able to work under pressure.

d: Khadoom is Qatar’s first AI-powered personal assistant, created to simplify and enhance customers’ daily lives. Operating across Qatar, Khadoom handles a wide range of tasks, including on-demand delivery, pet services, grocery shopping, personal shopping, and more. The platform leverages advanced technology to provide fast, reliable, and user-friendly services. Team members at Khadoom contribute directly to improving everyday experiences for a diverse customer base and supporting the growth of an innovative, service-focused technology company.
q: 0–2 years in software testing or QA (internships and freelance count)
Manual testing of web and mobile apps (iOS and Android)
Writing test cases and clear bug reports
Basic understanding of how apps work: frontend, backend, APIs and databases
Postman or a similar tool for API testing
Browser DevTools (console, network tab) to dig into issues
Understanding about Relational Databases and writing SQL queris
Understanding of Agentic chatbots and workflows (how LLMs respond, prompts, automated flows), or experience testing them

r: We are hiring a Junior QA Tester (0–2 years) in Doha. You will be the last check before anything reaches our customers: You will test our mobile app, web dashboards, APIs and AI chatbot, and make sure bugs are caught before users find them. Our product is chat-based: customers talk to our AI chatbot to get tasks done, so testing conversations is a big part of this role. You will work closely with our operations, customer support and development teams, so you always know what users are really facing.
This role is for people who are curious, detail-obsessed and love breaking things.
You own quality: if a bug reaches a customer, you want to know why
You're detail-obsessed and notice what others miss
You think like a user and try the unexpected
You communicate clearly and flag issues early
